title: Does anybody use AI asisted daily stock analysis tool?
author: _dread_89
selftext:
Hello Monkeys,

Recently I came accross a chinese(english asistance also) github repo which automize stock analysis by AI asistance. I set up the configurations and I am notified over telegram. Maybe we can validate results together with finance experts.
